field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable Kea-to-Unbound DDNS registration. On enable, the plugin turns on Kea's DDNS daemon and configures it automatically — no per-subnet setup required.

field.label: Qualifying suffix
field.help: Domain appended to bare hostnames to form FQDNs. Leave blank to use the firewall's domain.

field.label: Aggressive cleanup
field.help: When a host gets a new address, remove older addresses Kea no longer recognises for that host.

field.label: TSIG authentication
field.help: Authenticate DDNS updates with an auto-generated TSIG key (recommended).

field.label: Listener port
field.help: Loopback UDP port for the DDNS listener. Default 53535.
